name: Webflow Interactions (webflow.js IX2)
notes: webflow.js ships the IX2 engine as a Redux store whose action types are the strings IX2_RAW_DATA_IMPORTED / IX2_SESSION_STARTED …, and loads it with Webflow.require('ix2'). Newer sites split it into webflow.achunk.* / webflow.schunk.* files.

signals.label: Webflow IX2 engine inside a script
